# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.2 Stage 3 Package 2B, Late Iran 1411-1560 (oe_irt_). Generated by gen_iran_late.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Lightweight regional fallback monthly pulse for Late Iran 1411-1560 (slot 54).
# When BYZ scheduler slot 54 has already run this month, oe_irt_ran_m == oe_irt_m_now and this trigger is false.
# Keeps the line alive if BYZ falls or before slot 54 is registered in gen_mainline_lock.py.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_irt_fallback_pulse } }

oe_irt_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1337
        is_rebel_country = no
        NOT = { global_var:oe_irt_ran_m ?= oe_irt_m_now }
        OR = {
            oe_irt_human_fallback_eligible = yes
            tag = IRA
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:IRA } tag = AQQ }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:IRA } NOT = { country_exists = c:AQQ } tag = QAR }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:IRA } NOT = { country_exists = c:AQQ } NOT = { country_exists = c:QAR } tag = TIM }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:IRA } NOT = { country_exists = c:AQQ } NOT = { country_exists = c:QAR } NOT = { country_exists = c:TIM } tag = TUR }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_irt_monthly = yes
    }
}
